Earlier this year in May, OpenAI launched a dedicated mobile app version for enterprise users. Now, SpaceXAI is releasing a similar product for Grok.

Grok for Intune is now available

The enterprise-exclusive app is called Grok for Intune. SpaceXAI describes it as "the Microsoft Intune version of the Grok AI assistant, developed by xAI, designed for organizations that use Intune to manage apps and data."

The company noted: "It supports Intune mobile application management, complies with corporate app protection policies, and can be signed in with a company email account."

SpaceXAI highlighted that Grok for Intune has the following features:

AI Assistant Ask questions anytime and get instant answers; conduct in-depth online research, or tackle complex problems in mathematics, science, and programming. Upload documents and photos, or paste links, and let Grok analyze and explain the content. Grok Imagine Generate stunning images with simple text prompts, or upload images for Grok to edit, such as removing objects, changing scenes, or applying any artistic style. Use text prompts to create short videos with sound effects, or turn static photos into videos. Voice Mode Have a conversation with Grok and receive natural-sounding voice replies, hands-free. Live Camera: Share what you see in front of you and let Grok analyze and reason about it in real time. Real-time Information By accessing data from the web and X, Grok's answers can stay up to date with the latest information, trends, and developments on various topics. Designed for Managed Devices Deployed and configured by IT teams via Microsoft Intune. Complies with corporate app protection policies, including restrictions on storage, sharing, and data transfer. Sign in with a company email account. No in-app purchases.

Grok for Intune is now available on the App Store.
